answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the wander queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1667 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 365 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
